name: duopore-public-csv-column-mapping-plan
description: Plan which spreadsheet column goes into each field before you import a CSV file.

interface.longDescription: Plan which spreadsheet column goes into each field before you import a CSV file. Share your column headings, the fields you need, and your matching rules. Find missing source columns and fields mapped twice. Get a clear mapping plan to review. This tool does not read or change the CSV file itself.
defaultPrompt: Help me match these CSV columns to the fields I need.
Which required import fields are missing from my column plan?

positive.prompt: Use CSV Column Mapping Plan with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"headers":["Product Code","Price"],"requiredTargets":["sku","price","stock"],"mappings":[{"source":"Product Code","target":"sku"},{"source":"Price","target":"price"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 mapping issues found.","rows":[{"source":"Product Code","target":"sku","status":"mapped"},{"source":"Price","target":"price","status":"mapped"},{"source":"","target":"stock","status":"missing required target"}],"warnings":["Plan only; inspect the actual CSV encoding, quoting and values separately."]}
